description: US mattress brand (Zoma Sleep LLC, Scottsdale, Arizona) selling sports-recovery-focused memory-foam and hybrid mattresses, pillows, adjustable beds and bedding direct through Zomasleep.com. Its affiliate program is built around product reviewers: affiliates receive and test a mattress, publish their review, and earn commission on referred sales through Impact.

evidence.summary: Official Zoma affiliate page fetched in full: free to join with no startup or maintenance fees, a 90-day cookie duration, creative and marketing assets and dedicated affiliate support; affiliates are paid every month through Impact (the page's Become an Affiliate button leads to app.impact.com). Its FAQ answers the earnings question directly: 'How much can I earn? The sky's the limit! Your earning potential is uncapped and is based on your ability to drive purchases to Zomasleep.com.' The explicit uncapped statement on the brand's own page makes the commission cap UNCAPPED. The page publishes no percentage rate ('competitive payout terms', 'earn more as you sell more'), so commission_rate is null.

The same official page describes a reviewer workflow: 'After you receive and test your mattress, start publishing your review on your website with your affiliate link' — a product-seeded review program aimed at content publishers, with last-click attribution inside the 90-day cookie window.
